Traced masking.py:63-124 against the issue-context.md secret-word rule (line 35-37). split_label_words splits at non-isalnum chars (lines 103-111), so non-ASCII letters/digits stay in words and other characters split. _char_class/_split_chunk (63-96) make runs of upper, lower and digit/other, which gives lower-to-upper, letter-to-digit splits. An upper run followed by a lower run is split before its last capital (lines 89-91), and a single 's' keeps the run's s only when the chunk ends or a digit follows (86-87), matching the rule's 'end of label or before a non-letter'. Traces: APIKey -> api,key; OTPSecret -> otp,secret; PINs -> pins, which _word_matches (116) accepts as pin+s; PasswordHash -> password,hash; password2 -> password,2; PINS -> one word 'pins', also matched. _label_matches (119-124) does consecutive in-order matching as specified. Minor untested edge: titlecase/caseless letters fall into class L, which the rule does not cover.
